items: The shrink-swell property is a signature characteristic of Black soil frequently tested in competitive exams.
Remember that Gully erosion leads directly to the formation of badlands.
Identify the A horizon as the specific horizon richest in humus.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CLORPT model is used to explain the process of soil formation.
The A horizon is the layer richest in organic humus.
Laterization typically occurs under tropical climatic conditions.
Black soil exhibits a distinct shrink-swell property during dry and wet cycles.
Gully erosion destroys land and forms badlands topography.
Loamy soil offers optimal characteristics for crop cultivation and agriculture.
